Anyway, you can obtain the "Daimyo's Helmet Map" in the lower floor. A very very rare discovery map than can sell for billions of ducats. More than 20b from what I heard.

comments.author: Xiao Wei
comments.body:
What's with all the Russian text?

In anycase I still get plenty of EA goods from FSD and Songsunri even after 2nd age update. I tried Azuchi a few times on all 3 floors and Laurencio is right - It drops mostly junk like pearls and gold and Japanese Armour (these dont go for 30k+ like other nanban goods too!) and the enemies are surprisingly tougher then the other dungeons. On the hand it does drop some pretty nice equipment such as the Nanban Tsutsu, the best non-forged gun in the game.
